notes: Literal traces authored by visual inspection of original RGB crops, not copied from model predictions, map polygons or threshold masks.
Paving is visible pedestrian surfacing; roofs, raised ride objects and clear grass are non-paving. Hidden ground under canopy remains unknown.
All four sources have previously been used in development; no untouched final test is claimed.
Revision: source-reviewed roof extensions and conservative explicit uncertainty rings; model weights unchanged.
